resources.string: Choose a folder to explore. Files stay where they are.
Open a shared folder on your computer.
Read-only browsing: no files are changed.
Use the same Wi-Fi network and a shared folder on the computer. Enter its address and sign-in credentials.
Use the account password, not the Windows PIN. It is not saved.
Enter an address such as \\\\PC\\Photos or smb://PC/Photos.
This folder is unavailable. Choose it again to allow access.
Connection failed. Check the network, shared folder and credentials, then retry.
The initial values are examples. Please replace them with your shared folder address and computer account.
